customCSS: nav, .navbar, header { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(22px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); } [class*='card'], .room-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.52) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.68); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(30,58,138,0.07), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset; border-radius: 20px; transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 0.28s ease; } [class*='card']:hover, .room-card:hover { transform: translateY(-7px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 24px 56px rgba(30,58,138,0.14), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset; } h1 { font-weight: 200; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 5rem); } h2 { font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } button, .cta-btn { border-radius: 100px !important; } ::selection { background: rgba(129,140,248,0.28); color: #1e3a8a; } ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; background: #eff6ff; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #818cf8; border-radius: 10px; }
